findings.message: ends a process with `TerminateProcess`: the pid may belong to another process by now
findings.fix: End it through `paddock_proc` with a `ProcessId` (`kill_tree`, `end`, `terminate`; `Supervised` for a child), or through a handle or job object this process owns (ADR 0033). A justified case carries `// conformance: pid-kill — <reason>`.

findings.message: reads the raw parent pid `th32ParentProcessID`: its parent may have ended and the pid been handed on (Windows does so at once)
